Running a business in GTA V instead of playing a mission. On The Blade is a
roster and territory management mod for story mode — recruit a crew, post them
to corners, and drive out when the operation generates a problem.

Download (patrons): https://www.patreon.com/gtaontheblade
Everything else: https://ontheblade.com

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHAT IT IS

You don't play a minigame. You run a business — and answer for it when the night
goes wrong.

Everything stays at the abstraction the base game already uses: money, timers,
heat, fade to black. The interesting part was never the corner. It's deciding
who works it, when, and what you do the night a rival decides it's theirs.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHAT'S IN IT

• TWO WAYS TO EARN — an hourly street take that draws police heat, and a safe
  weekly deposit that only builds while a worker is OFF the street. They compete
  for the same hours, so your roster is a portfolio, not a throughput problem.

• SIX CORNERS, FOUR RIVAL CREWS — work a neutral corner to claim it, or take a
  held one by force. Rivals come back for turf you hold, and only turf you've
  actually staffed.

• A CREW WITH SHAPES — Hustlers earn on the street. Camera-ready ones build an
  audience. Fragile ones break when you push them. Loyal ones never walk.

• SHIFTS — days, nights, or always. Nights pay more; off-shift hours build
  followers and stamina instead.

• HEAT THAT BITES — let a corner run hot and vice turn it over. Everyone off the
  street, the block shut for days. Bribe it down, launder it away, or pay for it.

• SOMEBODY ELSE'S EARNER — half the people worth signing already work for
  someone. Take one and she arrives experienced, distrustful, and with her old
  crew right behind her. Every poach raises the temperature with EVERY crew.

• RIVALS YOU CAN NEGOTIATE WITH — pay a crew for peace and they leave your
  corners alone. Poach from them while you're paying and the deal's off, and
  they keep the money.

• A REAL WAY TO LOSE — wages, bail and fines you can't cover become debt, and
  debt compounds. Let it run and the people you owe come collecting.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

INSTALL

You'll need:
• GTA V — Legacy or Enhanced, STORY MODE ONLY
• Script Hook V for your edition
• ScriptHookVDotNet Enhanced 1.1.0.6+ — install this even on Legacy, the
  standard build won't load the mod on Enhanced
• .NET Framework 4.8 and Visual C++ 2019 x64

Drop three DLLs into your scripts folder and press F5. Full guide:
https://ontheblade.com/install.html

⚠ Story mode only. Loading script mods into GTA Online will get your account
banned.
